title: Can Water Boil and Freeze at the Same Time?
description:
At one exact combination of pressure and temperature, solid, liquid and vapour coexist.

At the triple point, water’s solid, liquid and gas phases can exist in equilibrium.

For a precise water composition this occurs near 0.01 C and a very low pressure; “boiling and freezing” is a visual simplification of phase equilibrium.

The water triple point was historically central to defining and realising temperature standards.
